Ads with no payback

You pay for every sign-up up front

Your ads already bring people in. With nothing to buy on the day, none of that spend comes back until someone joins a membership or a mastermind.

A big jump

Free, then straight to monthly or mastermind

The first paid step is a commitment. Most people who loved the challenge aren’t ready for that yet, so they leave with nothing to say yes to.

No buyer signal

You can’t tell curious from committed

A free sign-up shows interest. A purchase shows intent. Without one, there’s no list of proven buyers to invite into Beyond.

Your ads already fill the top of the funnel. Right now nothing in the middle turns those sign-ups into revenue, or into Beyond applications.

Ad scripts: hook, body, CTA

Three talking-to-camera scripts, each 30 to 45 seconds, filmed in your usual direct style.

Script 1 · “The edit”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Most women edit what they want before they’ve even said it out loud.”

Body

“You think it, then you shrink it. ‘That’s too much.’ ‘Who am I to ask?’ That reasonable voice isn’t wisdom. It’s habit. And habits can change in a week.”

CTA

“My Big Yes Audacity Kit is seven days of desire and audacity work. It’s $27. Tap the button and start Day 1 today.”

Shot: close-up to camera, on-screen text “no edits” in pink.

Script 2 · “The crumbs”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“When did you decide crumbs were enough?”

Body

“Not on purpose. It happens a little at a time. A skipped ask. A calendar full of other people. Pleasure saved for ‘later’. The Big Yes Audacity Kit is seven days to notice it, and to start taking up more room.”

CTA

“Workbook, daily audio and the exact words to say it. $27. Tap Shop now.”

Shot: walking to camera, cut to the workbook and audio on a phone.

Script 3 · “Say it out loud”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Say this out loud with me: I want more.”

Body

“Felt weird? Good. That’s the muscle we build. In my 7-day kit you practise the ask in private first, with a daily audio, then on Day 6 you make one real ask with my scripts.”

CTA

“The Big Yes Audacity Kit. Seven days, $27. Tap the button below.”

Shot: to camera, lime caption bars with each line of the script.
